newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ariadne buys car parking businesses.
newsitem.headline: Ariadne buys car parking businesses.

text.p: Investment company Ariadne Australia Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to buy the car parking businesses known as Kings Parking and Pacific Parking for A$12.65 million.
Ariadne said A$4.4 million of the purchase price would be paid in cash on settlement and the balance would be paid on a deferred basis over two years.
Kings Parking and Pacific Parking operate 47 car parks, with the majority of those car parks occupying prime positions in the Brisbane and Sydney central business districts.

Profits before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation of the businesses for the year ending June 30, 1997 were estimated at about A$2.7 million and Ariadne said it believes that profits, on the same basis, for the year ending June 30, 1998 would be about A$3 million.
The vendors of the businesses were associated with Ariadne director Kevin Seymour.
Ariadne said Seymour would continue to direct and enhance these businesses in his role as Ariadne's deputy chairman and one of its largest shareholders.
Ariadne expected that a shareholders meeting would be held towards the end of July to vote on the purchase.
